stories.text:
The keeper is fading away; the creator has not yet come.
But the world shall burn no more, for you shall ascend.
stories.title: Character Details

stories.text:
A boy and a girl stood amidst the tumult, under an unfamiliar sky.
You were a pair of traveling twins, passing through countless worlds during your journey.
Descending upon a continent named Teyvat, you hoped that you would be able to enjoy your time here.
But as you awoke among the falling stars, you saw the world in turmoil, a cataclysm raging across the land...
You sought to leave this place and move on to the next world, but then an unknown god stood before you, barring the way.
This deity was spotless, floating over a world of chaos.
Looking down on you.
The god took your only kin away, and you were sealed and cast into a deep slumber filled with nightmares...
When you reawakened, the world was changed.
The flames of war raged no longer, and nothing was left that looked familiar.
How long had you been asleep? You had no answers.
Thus, you began a lonely journey, seeking the deity that you had once laid eyes upon...
stories.title: Character Story 1

stories.text:
After that, you met Paimon, and wandered together for some time.
You learned that this world has seven deities who rule the seven nations as the Seven Archons.
Your first stop was the free city of wine and song, Mondstadt, a city built by the Anemo Archon.
As you stepped into Mondstadt as an outlander, it was, as the other nations were, beset on both sides by non-human and human threats.
The non-human threat was comprised of the confederacy known as the Abyss Order.
The human threat on the other hand, stemmed from the ambition of the Tsaritsa, god of Snezhnaya.
The Abyss Order had corrupted an ally of the Anemo Archon, the Dragon of the East of the Four Winds of Mondstadt.
The envoys of Snezhnaya, for their part, used this opposition to the Abyss as an excuse to put pressure on Mondstadt.
These threats from without and within caused the return of the Anemo Archon, who took on the form of a bard and joined you in your journey to save the dragon.
Yet there was something then that you did not see — for as the dragon fell to the Abyss, a certain figure had been reflected in its eyes...
The one who rules the Abyss.
He had once traveled with you, and you had once crossed many worlds together.
stories.title: Character Story 2

stories.text:
Though you made no promises, though it was an "agreement" the other party made one-sidedly,
You nonetheless set out on a sojourn across the Seven Nations to reach "the journey's end."
It would be a stretch to call this a pleasant path — as your feet took you forward, you witnessed and were pulled into the crises each nation faced...
Perhaps this is no coincidence. Perhaps some tremendous tremor deeper beneath the world is to blame for the waves of catastrophe.
The Tsaritsa's plan to collect the Gnoses persists apace, while the terrifying force corrupting the world awaits opportunities to strike.
And the Abyss Order, the organization led by your own flesh and blood...
From the Loom of Fate operational launch to the Atlas of the New World's completion, you know deep down that their actions are changing the fate of this world.
As you gradually understand said world, you have also come to understand the things your brother...
But this has not made your journey any easier, nor your footsteps lighter. That was not what you expected at first.
stories.title: Character Story 3

stories.text:
When faced with circumstances that they cannot control, humans often bemoan their powerlessness.
But if a person is found to have surpassing ambition even as their life reaches such a desperate turning point, then the gods would look upon them with favor.
This favor is the Vision, an external magical focus given to those who have been acknowledged by the gods which they can use to channel elemental power.
Celestia is the realm of the gods, and the wielders of Visions walk the earth below. When they depart from this world, the chosen will ascend.
After coming to this world, you often hear people speak of such things.
You, for your part, can never receive a Vision, for an alien lifeform does not belong...
Is it wise to allow a moment's ambition to dominate one's entire life?
You have needed to consider many such thought-provoking questions, ones that require lengthy consideration, during your journey through many worlds...
stories.title: Vision

voices.text:
Paimon: Mondstadt has so many windmills, doesn't it?
{NICKNAME}: Well, the city is built above water, so it probably relies on windmills to draw the water upwards.
Paimon: That's correct! The winds blow through Mondstadt all year, so this supply of water is very stable.
Paimon: Also, the windmills are what they call "visible winds" — and wind chimes are called the "audible winds."
Paimon: Paimon guesses they can be thought of as mascots and prayers to the Anemo Archon for protection.
{NICKNAME}: Ah, mascots. So, like you then, Paimon?
Paimon: No! Not at all! They're made of wood, and you can't eat them in an emergency either, 'cause all you'll do is grind your teeth down!
{NICKNAME}: Umm...
{NICKNAME}: ...I don't know what to say to that.
voices.title: About the Windmills

voices.text:
{NICKNAME}: I've heard that if you give tavern owners a considerable tip, they'll be willing to share some information on the down low.
Paimon: You mean the Angel's Share? But Master Diluc seems like a very rich man.
Paimon: How big a tip is "considerable," anyway?
{NICKNAME}: Huh... Maybe I might have heard wrong.
{NICKNAME}: Or, maybe I might have heard this rumor in another world...
Paimon: You sure have been to many worlds, haven't you?
voices.title: About the Tavern Owner

voices.text:
Paimon: Cider Lake never freezes, no matter what time of year it is.
Paimon: The best apple ciders in Mondstadt can only be made using the fresh water from this lake.
Paimon: It really does taste great! Paimon could drink two big bottles in a second!
{NICKNAME}: Wow.
Paimon: Tee-hee!
{NICKNAME}: With your size, I can't believe that you can drink that much liquid...
{NICKNAME}: ...And not explode like an Anemo Slime.
Paimon: Paimon has a special stomach just for tasty drinks!
{NICKNAME}: Huh... I guess the world really is a big place. So many things to consider...
voices.title: About Cider Lake

voices.text:
{NICKNAME}: About those books in the "restricted section" that Lisa mentioned...
{NICKNAME}: Have you ever wondered what sort of books might be kept in there?
{NICKNAME}: Perhaps...
{NICKNAME}: ...It contains books not suitable for children?
Paimon: Huh? But "The Boar Princess" isn't in the restricted section!
Paimon: What could be more unsuitable for children than that? ...Hmm, Paimon's curious...
voices.title: About the Library's Restricted Section

voices.text:
Paimon: Paimon finds that hard work hardly works here in Mondstadt.
{NICKNAME}: Why do you say that?
Paimon: Just look at Huffman from the Knights of Favonius. He does his best at his duties every day...
Paimon: But the ever-relaxed Captain Kaeya is his boss.
{NICKNAME}: Hmm... But isn't Jean, who works the hardest, the Acting Grand Master?
Paimon: W—Well, how about this, then...
Paimon: Venti's the god of Mondstadt, and he's the laziest of them all!
voices.title: About Effort and Reward

voices.text:
{NICKNAME}: Ah... Sure would be nice to spend a night at the Goth Grand Hotel...
Paimon: Paimon thinks so too!
Paimon: The rooms are sure to be big and clean.
{NICKNAME}: Still, I've heard Mr. Goth say that they've had all kinds of strange problems ever since the Fatui moved in.
{NICKNAME}: The Electro Cicins that their mages brought in attracted a lot of dust with static electricity, which ended up killing a lot of those Cicins.
{NICKNAME}: Then, someone mixed up the Mist Grass Pollen and the pepper...
{NICKNAME}: And the Agents ended up brawling amongst themselves, each insisting that the other owed them money for wine.
Paimon: ...Hang in there, Goth Grand Hotel...
voices.title: About the Goth Grand Hotel

voices.text:
{NICKNAME}: Everyone says that Mondstadt is the land of the wind.
{NICKNAME}: But, I wonder which direction the seasonal winds come from.
Paimon: Why don't we ask Venti?
{NICKNAME}: He'll probably just dodge the question with a "hehe" or something...
Paimon: True. The Anemo Archon is just a Tone-Deaf Bard. What does he know about the wind?
voices.title: About the Way the Wind Blows

voices.text:
{NICKNAME}: So here in Mondstadt, alchemy is practiced out on the streets?
Paimon: Is that so strange?
{NICKNAME}: In many of the worlds I've been to in the past, alchemy has always been a secretive art.
{NICKNAME}: Watching alchemy being practiced as a part of daily life is like being in a world where people all have three stomachs...
Paimon: Paimon thinks only having one stomach is weird!
{NICKNAME}: Uh...
{NICKNAME}: Are you serious?
Paimon: What do you think?
voices.title: About Alchemy

voices.text:
{NICKNAME}: Teyvat's day and night both seem particularly short.
{NICKNAME}: The skies here are full of stars, but they aren't the same as the ones back home.
{NICKNAME}: I wonder if the fates of people from Teyvat are also related to their constellations.
Paimon: Oh? Do you know how to read the stars, too? That's amazing! Not a lot of people outside Sumeru can do it.
Paimon: Paimon's curious! Come on, do a reading for me, quick!
{NICKNAME}: Hmm...
{NICKNAME}: The night sky pictured on Paimon's cape... flows with the light of many stars, and also of the deep ocean...
{NICKNAME}: The movement of these stars... tells me that, uh... in, say, seven days from now...
Paimon: ...In seven days what?
{NICKNAME}: Something good, or something bad, might occur...
Paimon: Heh, right... your theory sounds as rock solid as a Geo Slime... And about as brainy, too.
voices.title: About Teyvat

voices.text:
{NICKNAME}: On the way back to Mondstadt after rescuing Dvalin...
{NICKNAME}: We finally got to see one of the Seven Archons, didn't we? It was interesting to see what kind of god he was.
Paimon: Hmm... Haven't we known Venti for quite a while now?
{NICKNAME}: As Venti, yes... But still, this was the first time that we got to see him as the Anemo Archon, Barbatos.
{NICKNAME}: Normally, he hides his true divinity behind the facade of a bard.
{NICKNAME}: "What does freedom really mean, when demanded of you by a god?"
{NICKNAME}: That was the question that he asked Dvalin... I'm still contemplating that... you know?
voices.title: About the God of Freedom

voices.text:
Paimon: Mondstadt is full of wide plains and rolling hills.
Paimon: People say that when Barbatos made this land, he used the storm to flatten the cliffs and valleys...
{NICKNAME}: Still, it looks like he missed a few spots.
Paimon: Like Starsnatch Cliff?
{NICKNAME}: Exactly.
{NICKNAME}: On the map, it almost looks as if it was meant to be the apex of a vertical structure, but ended up at the wrong orientation.
Paimon: Wh—What's an "apex"?
voices.title: About Mondstadt's Terrain

voices.text:
Paimon: Paimon's heard that couplets are a traditional art form in Liyue. If you can write a line that works as a second half to one that someone else has written, you'll be well paid!
Paimon: But linking the couplet is hard, so it's not easy money.
Paimon: Not only does the rhythm need to match, but the meaning has to as well.
{NICKNAME}: Hmm... Care to give an example?
Paimon: Uh... "Windrise's winds never churn."
{NICKNAME}: ...Um, "But the Sea of Clouds' clouds always return."
Paimon: Huh... Not bad!
Paimon: Let's not waste time here. We've got some money to make!
voices.title: About Couplets

voices.text:
Paimon: There's a saying of Rex Lapis' that's commonly used here in Liyue. Paimon thinks its rough meaning is... "Don't play with your money."
Paimon: It's because the first Mora were minted from his golden form and given to humans in trust.
{NICKNAME}: Kaeya sure seems to enjoy playing with his money...
Paimon: And that's why you shouldn't learn from him.
{NICKNAME}: Well, as a child, I was taught not to play with my food.
Paimon: Yup, yup. You've got to respect your food.
Paimon: ...Wh—What are you looking at Paimon for?
voices.title: About "Don't Play With Food, or With Money"

voices.text:
Paimon: Walk in seven clockwise circles, then walk in seven anticlockwise circles, then open your eyes...
{NICKNAME}: Are you... sleepwalking?
Paimon: Nope! Paimon is just trying to see if that antique shop from "Heart's Desire" actually exists!
{NICKNAME}: Well, assuming that a shop in a story does exist, what would you like to buy, Paimon?
Paimon: A Slime Creator!
{NICKNAME}: Does such a thing even exist?
voices.title: About Heart's Desire

voices.text:
{NICKNAME}: Lately, some Guhua Clan disciples have been retelling an ancient story.
Paimon: The Guhua Clan, huh? Paimon bets it's a heroic story!
{NICKNAME}: Several female disciples decided to partake of a contest of arms to see who would marry their male junior, and he approved.
Paimon: Ooh, Paimon's heard this one. In Liyue, they call this "a joust for a spouse"!
{NICKNAME}: But the night before the contest, he stole the eldest disciple's favorite sword.
Paimon: Ah, so he wanted her to lose... Poor girl...
{NICKNAME}: I know, right? Forced to use a sword she wasn't used to, the eldest disciple suffered a crushing defeat.
{NICKNAME}: Unable to accept this result, she fell to her knees and wept.
Paimon: Oh no... She must have really loved him, right?
{NICKNAME}: In the end, she was forced to marry him in front of everyone. Hahaha.
Paimon: Wait... so the loser had to marry him!?
voices.title: About the Guhua Clan

voices.text:
Paimon: Did you know the reeds in Dihua Marsh are common materials used in making paper?
Paimon: The solid reed cores are used to make pens, while the hollow part is used to make flutes. It's all very sophisticated.
Paimon: Over the years, many heroes and swordsmen have also chosen Dihua Marsh as the location of their duels.
Paimon: The more reeds, the more elegant the place. But in places where the reeds are the thickest, the water can be quite deep...
Paimon: So there are a lot of unlucky duelists who fall in and drown while the duel is on...
{NICKNAME}: Huh. And what's my takeaway from all of this supposed to be?
Paimon: Don't get into a fight in Dihua Marsh!
voices.title: About Dihua Marsh

voices.text:
Paimon: Paimon's heard that in Liyue, people call the crane the "gentleman bird."
{NICKNAME}: And do you know why that is?
Paimon: Hmm... Paimon's not quite sure...
{NICKNAME}: Well then, let me tell you about the story of the lucky crane repaying its debts.
{NICKNAME}: A long, long time ago, there was a kind-hearted scholar who saved a lucky crane that had fallen into a trap.
{NICKNAME}: Later, on a cold winter's night, a beautiful maiden came to his door, asking to lodge with him.
{NICKNAME}: The maiden shouldered a greatsword on her back, and taught all that she knew of swordsmanship to the scholar, supervising him as he studied day and night.
Paimon: Whoa...
{NICKNAME}: Once he had finished his training, he went out into the wilds with the maiden to do good and fight for justice.
{NICKNAME}: Ten years later, the lucky crane took the form of a gentleman, and finally came to return the favor, but discovered the couple had already lived out a fortuitous life...
{NICKNAME}: And that's the story known as "The Gentleman's 10-Year Debt."
Paimon: Ahh...
voices.title: About the Gentleman Bird

voices.text:
{NICKNAME}: Rumor has it that Jueyun Karst is the abode of the adepti.
Paimon: Wow — the abode of the adepti!
{NICKNAME}: Perhaps we'll meet the adepti on those cloud-piercing mountain peaks.
Paimon: Wow — meeting adepti!
{NICKNAME}: But I wonder... how would one normally communicate with the adepti?
Paimon: Wow — communicating with adepti!
{NICKNAME}: Hmm. My emergency rations seem to be going bad. *sigh* Best to consume them quickly...
Paimon: Ahem. Well... Paimon thinks that shouting from the mountaintop should work.
{NICKNAME}: That seems more like a way for getting the attention of a hilichurl instead of an adeptus.
voices.title: About Jueyun Karst

voices.text:
{NICKNAME}: To think that the Geo Archon had signed a contract with the Cryo Archon.
{NICKNAME}: I wonder what the contents of their agreement were...
Paimon: Paimon doesn't care who you are, making a deal with the Tsaritsa is super dangerous!
{NICKNAME}: Be that as it may...
{NICKNAME}: Since Morax is the god who understands the basis of contracts the best...
{NICKNAME}: He's definitely given this some thought.
Paimon: Well that's true. Morax himself called it the "contract to end all contracts"...
{NICKNAME}: I trust that we will witness the truth, and its denouement, play out...
voices.title: About the God of Contracts

voices.text:
Paimon: Come to think of it, while Rex Lapis enjoys visiting his people in private, he only descends officially once every year.
Paimon: None of the other gods do this. Hmm... Does Rex Lapis have any deeper intentions?
{NICKNAME}: I have my guesses...
{NICKNAME}: You see, those annual divine predictions have already captured the hearts of the people of Liyue too much.
{NICKNAME}: Round and around they analyze and scrutinize every single word, finding limitless "hidden meanings" within them...
{NICKNAME}: What do you think would happen to Liyue if such divine predictions were available every day?
Paimon: Ah!
Paimon: Paimon gets it now. Paimon would be offering Rex Lapis' favorite snacks to him every day!
Paimon: If you could just get Mora straight from Morax's hands, who would ever need to do a day of honest work?
{NICKNAME}: You made... some logical leaps, but that's basically how it is.
voices.title: About Divine Predictions in Liyue

voices.text:
Paimon: If you want to adventure together with Benny's Adventure Team, you have to come prepared.
Paimon: Domains are very dangerous, so you should always take care to double- and triple-check your supplies in advance.
Paimon: Paimon's heard that the Adventurers' Guild has compiled a list of 463 different ways of dying in these domains...
Paimon: If Bennett got you killed by accident, Paimon and Bennett would never forgive ourselves!
{NICKNAME}: ...Why am I the only one dying here?
Paimon: Well, that's because according to the numbers, Paimon can avoid 322 causes of death just by floating!
{NICKNAME}: I suddenly don't feel like exploring these domains...
voices.title: About Benny's Adventure Team

voices.text:
{NICKNAME}: I've heard that Albert, being the leader of Barbara's fan club...
{NICKNAME}: ...Sometimes gets bumps and bruises on purpose so that he can go to the Cathedral to see her.
Paimon: Paimon feels the Knights of Favonius should keep a closer watch on weirdos like that.
{NICKNAME}: But it seems that a month later, Albert discovered that Bennett was managing to see Barbara far more than he was.
{NICKNAME}: On second thought, Bennett does have the natural advantage when it comes to getting injured.
Paimon: What is this, a "let's bother Barbara" contest?
voices.title: About Bennett

voices.text:
Paimon: Barbara's really popular, isn't she?
{NICKNAME}: Well, she is the idol of the people of Mondstadt.
Paimon: Come to think of it... Paimon doesn't really know what an "idol" is.
{NICKNAME}: It's an occupation in which one's work is to be cute, be well-loved, and earn a boat-load of Mora.
Paimon: Isn't that the same thing as being a mascot?
{NICKNAME}: That's... one way to put it.
voices.title: About the "Idol"

voices.text:
{NICKNAME}: Lisa and Amber feel a bit like sisters.
Paimon: Huh? Why's that?
{NICKNAME}: Amber often runs errands for Lisa. Older siblings asking their younger siblings to do things for them so they can slack off is a rather common practice...
{NICKNAME}: But, my brother and I are the same age, so we had to decide these things via rock-paper-scissors.
Paimon: Whoa. So, doesn't that make you my younger sister?
{NICKNAME}: What do you mean?
Paimon: Well, since Paimon floats, you're the only one who can "run" any errands!
{NICKNAME}: ...Seriously?
voices.title: About Being Sisters

voices.text:
{NICKNAME}: Paimon, have you ever seen what Kaeya looks like under that eye patch?
Paimon: Nope.
{NICKNAME}: So, it would seem that he never takes it off...
Paimon: Actually, Paimon already knows why!
{NICKNAME}: Oh?
Paimon: He must be hiding some big secret!
{NICKNAME}: Really, a secret?
Paimon: See, Kaeya heads out for assignments more than anyone else.
Paimon: So the skin under that eye patch has to be way lighter than the rest of him.
{NICKNAME}: So if he ever takes that eye patch off...
Paimon: He'll definitely become the butt of everyone's jokes. Maybe he'll even get a weird nickname!
Paimon: Like, say, "Pasty Eye"!
{NICKNAME}: Guess he didn't need to take it off to get a weird nickname...
voices.title: About Kaeya's Eye Patch

voices.text:
Paimon: Strange...
{NICKNAME}: What's wrong?
Paimon: Diluc and Kaeya are really alike, so why don't they get along?
{NICKNAME}: How are they alike, again?
Paimon: Well, Kaeya's the kind of guy who acts shady in the light of day...
Paimon: While Diluc is a shining beacon of justice in the dark of night!
Paimon: Don't you think that's kinda the same thing...?
{NICKNAME}: Uhh... I still don't see it.
voices.title: About Kaeya and Diluc

voices.text:
{NICKNAME}: If one hilichurl could beat, say, three wild boars...
{NICKNAME}: Then how many hilichurls would it take to reach the fighting prowess of Master Jean and Master Diluc?
Paimon: Not sure... but if you heard the way everyone talks in Mondstadt, you'd know that Master Jean is the strongest.
{NICKNAME}: I'd say that if Diluc strikes first, Master Jean wouldn't be able to counter.
Paimon: Oh, she'd find a way.
{NICKNAME}: There's no way.
Paimon: Master Jean's Elemental Burst is really strong, you know~
{NICKNAME}: Yes, but that "field" would also make Diluc stronger.
Paimon: Paimon doesn't think Master Jean would even need her Vision to take on Master Diluc, because—
{NICKNAME}: Diluc would only need a beginner's greatsword to—
Paimon: Argh...
{NICKNAME}: Ugh...
{NICKNAME}: *sigh* This... is so dumb.
{NICKNAME}: They both fight for Mondstadt, so they wouldn't come to blows.
Paimon: That's why Paimon likes your idea of measuring their fighting strength in number of hilichurls.
Paimon: ...Or in Paimon's case, in fifths of a wild boar.
voices.title: About Measuring Fighting Strength

voices.text:
Paimon: {NICKNAME}, you know what a brush is, right?
{NICKNAME}: Of course! Kinda like pens but with animal hair at one end for calligraphy, right?
Paimon: That's correct! They say that finely-made brushes sell for high prices among Liyue's merchants!
{NICKNAME}: So, would you like to make some too?
Paimon: Uh-huh! But wild wolves are too fierce, so we should use Razor's fur to make brushes instead!
Paimon: Razor's fur is all downy and soft. It'll definitely make great wolf-fur brushes! We could make lots of Mora like this!
{NICKNAME}: Brushes made like that would conduct electricity. I'm not sure we could use them.
{NICKNAME}: Besides, Razor isn't a wolf, nor are wolf brushes made from actual wolves' fur...
Paimon: Huh? Why are they called wolf-fur brushes, then?
{NICKNAME}: Well, does Cider Lake look like it's full of cider to you?
Paimon: Hmm. You have a point.
voices.title: About Razor

voices.text:
Paimon: Klee's a really interesting kid.
Paimon: All the Knights seem to like her a lot, too. You could even say they spoil her.
{NICKNAME}: I wonder, who makes the better mascot: Paimon, or Klee?
{NICKNAME}: Oh wait, I forgot. Paimon's not a mascot, Paimon is emergency—
Paimon: Hey! Paimon knows exactly what you're going to say. That joke stopped being funny a long time ago.
voices.title: About Klee

voices.text:
Paimon: It's time for Paimon's Little Life Tips!
{NICKNAME}: "Little Life Tips"?
Paimon: In Mondstadt, if there's something you can't fix, or there's something you can't get clean no matter what you do...
Paimon: If you ever run into something you can't handle yourself, you just need to shout this name into the skies:
Paimon: "Noeeeelle!"
Paimon: And everything that's troubling you will be swept away in an instant.
{NICKNAME}: So this is one of the tricks to living in Mondstadt... Pretty impressive...
voices.title: About the "Wondermaid"

voices.text:
Paimon: Fischl makes a very unique impression, doesn't she?
{NICKNAME}: How so?
Paimon: Well, she travels together with a talking raven, for starters.
{NICKNAME}: Well, I'm traveling with you. It's not all that different.
{NICKNAME}: Still, Oz can also translate for Fischl. You, on the other hand...
Paimon: What!? Paimon's way better than some bird!
{NICKNAME}: Haha, how so?
Paimon: Well, um... uh... at least Paimon doesn't need wings to fly!
voices.title: About Fischl

voices.text:
{NICKNAME}: Speaking of Fischl, she also claims to be a "visitor from another world"...
{NICKNAME}: We're similar in that way. We even bring a pet along with us.
Paimon: Pet? Now, wait just a minute, here...
{NICKNAME}: But her raven, Oz... He looks cool, and is polite to boot.
{NICKNAME}: More importantly, he can both scout and fight — very useful indeed.
{NICKNAME}: Maybe I should make arrangements with Fischl to trade companions once in a while for, say, a week or two at a time? Hehe, it should be quite interesting.
Paimon: Hey! Doesn't Paimon get a say in this!?
voices.title: About Pets

voices.text:
Paimon: How do you become as popular and cool as Captain Beidou?
{NICKNAME}: With enough experience...?
Paimon: Paimon's already seen lots of things from adventuring together with you!
{NICKNAME}: One also needs to experience trials and setbacks...
Paimon: Paimon almost drowned that one time...
{NICKNAME}: ...And maintain an inspirational disposition...
Paimon: Uh-huh! Paimon's always rooted for you!
{NICKNAME}: One must also have a... mature outlook towards problems.
Paimon: Hey! Are you just trying to say that Paimon can't make it?
voices.title: About Beidou

voices.text:
Paimon: How does a person become as rich... no, as super rich as Lady Ningguang?
{NICKNAME}: Hah... Is that the only impression she gives you? Riches?
Paimon: Well, there's the huge Jade Chamber, too! But isn't that also made of Mora?
{NICKNAME}: Well, you need an excellent mind...
Paimon: Well... Paimon's really good at giving people nicknames!
{NICKNAME}: You need to be very familiar with the workings of the markets...
Paimon: A serving of Fisherman's Toast goes for 1,025 Mora, and no discounts — even on rainy days.
{NICKNAME}: You also need to be willing to work really hard...
Paimon: Okay then... so, how do you make friends with a really rich person?
{NICKNAME}: Wait, you're giving up already!?
voices.title: About Ningguang

voices.text:
Paimon: Umm... Do you think that Qiqi... needs to drink blood?
{NICKNAME}: That's not a zombie, Paimon. That's a vampire.
Paimon: Then, will she transform during a full moon?
{NICKNAME}: Werewolves, Paimon. Not zombies.
Paimon: Huh... As expected of a traveler, you really know a lot!
Paimon: So, what special things can zombies do?
{NICKNAME}: Exercises?
Paimon: Ah, that makes a lot of sense! So, the ones that do exercises are zombies — got it!
voices.title: About Qiqi Being a Zombie

voices.text:
Paimon: Come on, {NICKNAME}, Paimon'll teach you how to fly!
Paimon: Three, two, one!
{NICKNAME}: Ah, Paimon's gone.
{NICKNAME}: Well, whatever. *sigh* I'm tired. Let's just... sit here for a bit.
{NICKNAME}: *yawn* I'm flying with you... in my heart... Mm...
voices.title: About Flying

voices.text:
Paimon: What sort of slime do you like the most, {NICKNAME}?
{NICKNAME}: Cryo Slimes, I think. You feel cold just getting close to them — you'll need that sort of thing in summer.
Paimon: That's very practical, as expected of a traveler.
{NICKNAME}: What about you, Paimon?
Paimon: Paimon likes them all! They're all very tasty!
{NICKNAME}: Tasty, huh...
Paimon: Turning slimes into bubbly, lovely, jubbly meals is the Paimon Special!
{NICKNAME}: Well then...
{NICKNAME}: I suppose that's one more thing I can eat before you become emergency rations, huh, Paimon?
Paimon: Uhh... Paimon would rather not be on that list at all!
voices.title: About Slimes

voices.text:
{NICKNAME}: Do you think that we're too harsh on the hilichurls?
Paimon: Well... sometimes we really do seem like children who just can't resist kicking the hornet's nest...
{NICKNAME}: I think we're doing more than just kicking it...
voices.title: About Hilichurls

voices.text:
{NICKNAME}:  The "Sleeper tribe"... The hilichurls sure have interesting tribe names.
Paimon: The Sleeper tribe will take any opportunity they can to take a nap.
Paimon: Paimon's heard that their animal-skin beds are really soft. Would you like to try them?
{NICKNAME}: Not gonna try it yourself, Paimon?
Paimon: Paimon can sleep while floating! The air is the softest bed. Pretty sweet, huh?
{NICKNAME}: ...Just a little.
voices.title: About the Sleepers

voices.text:
{NICKNAME}: The "Meaty tribe," huh? These hilichurls pick the funniest names.
Paimon: The hilichurls of the Meaty tribe make regular sacrifices. The altars they build are really huge.
{NICKNAME}: What do they pray for?
Paimon: "For meat to eat every day"! It's an awesome wish, isn't it?
{NICKNAME}: ...I suppose I should have expected that answer.
voices.title: About the Meaties

voices.text:
{NICKNAME}: The "Eclipse tribe"... Huh. So the hilichurls have normal-sounding tribe names like these, too.
Paimon: The hilichurls of the Eclipse tribe are really mysterious.
Paimon: All the hilichurls of that tribe can draw an eclipse symbol.
Paimon: But rumor has it that only the Dada Samachurl of the Eclipse tribe knows why the eclipse symbol is so revered within their tribe.
{NICKNAME}: An eclipse symbol...
Paimon: Hmm? Did you say something, {NICKNAME}?
{NICKNAME}: Ah... I was... asking you what sort of soup you'd like to have tonight.
Paimon: Can't stop thinking about food, huh? Seems like you'd be more at home in the Meaty tribe than the Eclipse tribe. But anyway, Paimon wants boar soup. Thanks!
voices.title: About the Eclipse Tribe

voices.text:
Paimon: Paimon doesn't feel so good...
{NICKNAME}: What's the matter?
Paimon: Paimon hasn't opened a treasure chest in so long. If this keeps up... *whimpers*
{NICKNAME}: If this keeps up, you'll one day get caught in a hunting trap with a single Mora as bait...
Paimon: Hey! Paimon floats, so that'll never work.
voices.title: About Riches

voices.text:
Paimon: Wow, we've really had a lot of good food recently, haven't we?
Paimon: You know what they say: "Have food, will travel"!
{NICKNAME}: Hmm... Won't you be unable to fly if you get fat?
Paimon: Nope! Paimon never gets fat!
{NICKNAME}: Huh...
Paimon: So Paimon demands more food!
{NICKNAME}: Ever eating but never growing... Don't you fail as emergency rations, then?
Paimon: Yeah, yeah... Well it sure doesn't look like you have any other candidates... So you'll have to make do with Paimon!
voices.title: About Weight Gain

voices.text:
Paimon: Which do you like more: cats or dogs?
{NICKNAME}: I prefer Paimon.
Paimon: Aww, that's cheating~!
Paimon: Wait, no! Paimon's not a pet!
voices.title: About Cat People and Dog People

voices.text:
Paimon: People say that if you put a Starconch close to your ear, you can hear the whispers of the ocean!
{NICKNAME}: Do you want to give it a go, Paimon?
Paimon: No need, Paimon just heard it!
{NICKNAME}: Really? And what did the ocean say?
Paimon: The ocean said... that it's time to eat, so let's go! Paimon wants some Fisherman's Toast!
voices.title: About the Sound of the Ocean

voices.text:
Paimon: We should get something tasty to eat! Uh, but Paimon doesn't wanna have to go get it...
{NICKNAME}: Hmm, shall we decide with a game of rock-paper-scissors, then?
Paimon: Ooh, okay!
{NICKNAME}: Great! Alright, ready? Rock, paper—
Paimon: —Super Paimon Tornado!
{NICKNAME}: ...What?
voices.title: About Rock, Paper, Scissors

voices.text:
Paimon: Phew! Paimon's been working so hard recently. Any ideas on how to relax?
{NICKNAME}: Uhh... Sleeping?
Paimon: Sleeping's boring.
{NICKNAME}: Reading?
Paimon: Paimon'll get dizzy.
{NICKNAME}: ...Okay, having a chat with some friends?
Paimon: ...Ugh.
Paimon: But those're all things that require thinking.
Paimon: And not thinking is more relaxing.
{NICKNAME}: *sigh* And thus the "Paimon Paradox," famed in the histories of philosophy in Teyvat, was put forth...
voices.title: About Relaxing

voices.text:
{NICKNAME}: Liyue's cuisine is very different from that of Mondstadt.
{NICKNAME}: For example, in Mondstadt you can hardly find spicy fried dishes anywhere.
Paimon: That's why they say "climate creates cuisine," ya know?
Paimon: But wait... Why do all of Teyvat's slimes taste the same, then?
{NICKNAME}: That's because you only know one way of cooking them...
voices.title: About Dietary Differences

voices.text:
Paimon: Wow, a weasel thief's backpack can really hide a lot of Mora!
{NICKNAME}: Well, it's because weasels, by nature, enjoy collecting shiny objects.
Paimon: Paimon's heard that the origin of the weasel thieves has something to do with the Treasure Hoarders...
Paimon: Also, aren't crows the type to collect shinies as well?
Paimon: Paimon wonders if Oz has a secret stash of Mora that he collects behind Fischl's back.
{NICKNAME}: Well, now that you mention it, Paimon...
{NICKNAME}: I wonder, do you have—
Paimon: —Uhh... Nope. Nothing here! You won't find any Mora in Paimon's shoes, no way!
voices.title: About Saving Money

voices.text:
{NICKNAME}: Paimon, have you ever read "Vera's Melancholy" before?
Paimon: Well, it sure sounds familiar!
{NICKNAME}: That book's pretty popular, and I've heard that the author made a tidy sum off of it...
Paimon: *sigh* Paimon would love to make lots and lots of Mora...
Paimon: Hmm... It's decided, then! Paimon will write an adventure story as well!
{NICKNAME}: A tale of adventure, by Paimon?
Paimon: Correct! It'll be a story in which the brave traveler defeats the dragon, saves the world...
Paimon: And then sits down with her reliable companion for ten servings of Sticky Honey Roast!
{NICKNAME}: ...Ten!?
Paimon: Uh-huh! A happy ending attracts the readers, after all!
Paimon: It's decided, then! We'll call it "Paimon's Happiness!"
{NICKNAME}: Wait, what?
voices.title: About Adventure Stories

voices.text:
Paimon: Have you ever had one of those super scary nightmares, {NICKNAME}?
{NICKNAME}: Um, I've dreamt of falling through endless darkness...
{NICKNAME}: Without a wind glider.
Paimon: Eek...
{NICKNAME}: I've also dreamt of my brother walking away from me, while I'm unable to catch up to him no matter how fast I run.
{NICKNAME}: ...He tells me that I've "come too late."
Paimon: Oh...
Paimon: Yours are quite different from the ones that Paimon's had.
Paimon: Paimon's scariest dream was being eaten by a super giant slime.
voices.title: About Nightmares

voices.text:
{NICKNAME}: I wonder where those treasure-chasing Seelie come from.
Paimon: Maybe they grow out of the ground — or maybe they fall from trees?
Paimon: Well, Paimon doesn't know where they come from, but where there are Seelie, treasure's not far away!
{NICKNAME}: *sigh* Still... why do I feel a certain sadness every time they touch those treasures?
Paimon: Hmm?
{NICKNAME}: ...No, it's probably just my imagination.
Paimon: Well... if you don't want the treasure, Paimon can hang onto it for you, free of charge!
voices.title: About Seelie

voices.text:
Paimon: Has anyone left a big impression on you during our recent travels?
Paimon: For Paimon, that's Sara.
{NICKNAME}: Timmie.
Paimon: ...Huh? Why him?
{NICKNAME}: *sigh* His face comes to mind every time I've eaten a Sweet Madame recently... Really makes it hard to chow down.
voices.title: About Someone Unforgettable

voices.text:
Paimon: You learn new things so quickly.
Paimon: You've already got such a good grasp of Teyvat's language.
{NICKNAME}: You're a good teacher, Paimon.
Paimon: Aww, hehehe...
{NICKNAME}: Who knows, maybe the quality of your nasty nicknames will improve someday.
voices.title: About Language

voices.text:
{NICKNAME}: What monster made the deepest impression on you?
Paimon: Monsters, huh? Probably... Ruin Guards.
{NICKNAME}: Does a Ruin Guard really count as a monster? It's more like a machine...
Paimon: Paimon thinks that you can call anything that causes us trouble and needs to be defeated a "monster."
Paimon: Just like how we call anything that can be hunted "prey."
{NICKNAME}: Is that so... Well then, I think I'm finally able to classify you now, Paimon.
Paimon: Eh? What do you mean?
{NICKNAME}: You can be hooked and reeled in... therefore, you're a fish!
Paimon: Hmph!
voices.title: About Paimon's Species

voices.text:
Paimon: Hey, do that again! You know, that thing!
{NICKNAME}: Which one?
Paimon: The one where you make your weapon disappear with a swish, and then, fwoosh — you make it appear behind your back again!
{NICKNAME}: Oh, that. Haven't you seen that a ton already?
Paimon: But Paimon hasn't figured out how you do it yet. Could you explain it?
{NICKNAME}: Well, can you explain how you suddenly appear in front of me, and then disappear just as suddenly?
Paimon: Uh... well... Paimon seems to have always been able to do this. But Paimon doesn't know how...
{NICKNAME}: Precisely. I believe that the art of putting my weapon away follows the same principle.
{NICKNAME}: Maybe it's this similarity that makes us such good friends.
voices.title: About Storing Weapons

voices.text:
Paimon: {NICKNAME}, what do you think of treasure chests?
{NICKNAME}: I believe that they were left behind by great travelers who once passed this way.
{NICKNAME}: Every time I open one and look at its contents, I can feel a certain kinship with those who came before...
Paimon: And that's how you get adventure experience!
voices.title: About Chests

voices.text:
Paimon: Look into Paimon's eyes!
{NICKNAME}: Something the matter?
Paimon: Kaeya said that people's eyes will betray them.
Paimon: He can tell if someone is telling the truth or not just by looking into their eyes.
{NICKNAME}: Huh...
Paimon: Paimon loves Fisherman's Toast!
{NICKNAME}: That should be the truth. Haha, well, that's also because you love everything that can be eaten.
Paimon: Hehe.
{NICKNAME}: Speaking of looking into people's eyes... I remember one gaze that left a particularly deep impression on me.
Paimon: Whose gaze was that?
{NICKNAME}: A Ruin Guard's. Really made me want to poke its eye out...
voices.title: About Eyes

voices.text:
Paimon: Ugh, Paimon's so bored... So tired...
{NICKNAME}: Well, since we're bored either way, wanna imitate the other Knights for fun?
Paimon: Huh? Isn't that a bit disrespectful?
{NICKNAME}: Haha, I see you already have the knightly virtue of modesty and politeness. Very impressive.
Paimon: Hey! Paimon sees what you're doing. Cut it out!
voices.title: About Imitating Others

voices.text:
Paimon: Urrrrgh...
{NICKNAME}: Huh? Are there pigeons around?
Paimon: No, Paimon's just hungry.
Paimon: What Paimon needs right now is a traveler who can whip up some delicious Sticky Honey Roast.
Paimon: So, who's going to be the lucky traveler? Hmm?
voices.title: About the Luck of the Draw

voices.text: Huh!
voices.title: Elemental Skill: I

voices.text: Hah!
voices.title: Elemental Skill: II

voices.text: Wind blade!
voices.title: Elemental Skill: III

voices.text: Huh!
voices.title: Elemental Skill: IV

voices.text: Drop!
voices.title: Elemental Skill: V

voices.text: Starfall!
voices.title: Elemental Skill: VI

voices.text: Hah!
voices.title: Elemental Skill: VII

voices.text: Take this!
voices.title: Elemental Skill: VIII

voices.text: Lightning Slash!
voices.title: Elemental Skill: IX

voices.text: Hyah!
voices.title: Elemental Burst: I

voices.text: Be gone!
voices.title: Elemental Burst: II

voices.text: Prepare to be blown away!
voices.title: Elemental Burst: III

voices.text: Haah!
voices.title: Elemental Burst: IV

voices.text: Shake!
voices.title: Elemental Burst: V

voices.text: Crumble apart!
voices.title: Elemental Burst: VI

voices.text: He!
voices.title: Elemental Burst: VII

voices.text: Thunder Clap!
voices.title: Elemental Burst: VIII

voices.text: Bellowing Thunder!
voices.title: Elemental Burst: IX

voices.text: Is this... an answer from this world?
voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: I

voices.text: A reward on the road.
voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: II

voices.text: I'll keep this close.
voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: III

voices.text: Let me take over!
voices.title: Ally at Low HP: I

voices.text: Look out!
voices.title: Ally at Low HP: II

voices.text: This is not the end...
voices.title: Fallen: I

voices.text: Maybe I wasn't meant for this world...
voices.title: Fallen: II

voices.text: Just what will we come across this time?
voices.title: Joining Party: I

voices.text: This world is full of unsolved mysteries...
voices.title: Joining Party: II

voices.text: There's still a long road ahead.
voices.title: Joining Party: III

voices.text:
Paimon: It's hard to talk about the recent events in Inazuma and not mention the Vision Hunt Decree.
Paimon: But you don't have a Vision, so you don't have to worry about losing one.
Paimon: On the flip side, if you are caught by the Tenryou Commission, {NICKNAME}, you also can't surrender your Vision in exchange for your life...
{NICKNAME}: I can tell them that you are my Vision.
Paimon: Another reason to have Paimon around... Wait, WHAT!?
{NICKNAME}: Don't worry, I wouldn't let them take you, Paimon.
Paimon: That's more like it.
{NICKNAME}: We'd just go to jail and suffer punishment together...
Paimon: Uh... W—Well, if that's how it would go down, then maybe you should hand me over to them...
Paimon: ...Wait a minute! How about we just don't get caught in the first place?
voices.title: About the Vision Hunt Decree

voices.text:
Paimon: Only the ones who have the will to fight back are allowed into the Resistance!
Paimon: Huh. In that case, Paimon also qualifies as a member.
{NICKNAME}: And what exactly are you trying to resist, Paimon?
Paimon: Paimon has been resisting against the fate of being squished all this time!
{NICKNAME}: Then you probably won't get in.
Paimon: Why? Is it because Paimon isn't fighting for the same cause as the Resistance?
{NICKNAME}: It's because you're fighting for a lost cause, I'm afraid...
Paimon: *sob* Y—You meanie!
voices.title: About the Resistance

voices.text:
Paimon: Kamuileon... Cannon? Kamuijuicy... Cannon? Kamuijimmy... Cannon? Ugh... What a mouthful.
{NICKNAME}: What are you reading, Paimon?
Paimon: Look, it's the super weapon the Shogunate army has constructed nearby to protect Tatarasuna.
Paimon:  Kamuijima! Cannon!
{NICKNAME}: It looks really powerful... And yet, we didn't see it do anything while we were in Tatarasuna.
Paimon: It seems like the Resistance knew how strong it was, so before formally waging war against the Shogunate, they had covertly occupied this place.
Paimon: But this Kamui... Kamuijima Cannon needs either special ammunition or Electro to work, so it's no use to the Resistance.
Paimon: The Shogunate army put so much time and effort into creating this weapon... Paimon really wants to see the extent of its power.
{NICKNAME}: If all you need is an Electro user, perhaps I can help.
Paimon: That's right! Now we just need something that would serve as our cannon ball...
Paimon: Huh? ...Why are you giving me that look? Hey—
voices.title: About Kamuijima Cannons

voices.text:
Paimon: You know what? When we first arrived at the Komore Teahouse, Paimon really thought that Taroumaru would be able to speak...
{NICKNAME}: You sound a bit disappointed.
Paimon: Of course! If Taroumaru could speak, Paimon feels that he'd say something really interesting!
{NICKNAME}: For example?
Paimon: Hmm... "Thoma, stop hiding around here, you're in my way! *woof*"
{NICKNAME}: That makes sense.
Paimon: Or... "Kozue, you're bound to me for the rest of your life, unless our contract is terminated! *woof* *woof*"
{NICKNAME}: You didn't believe Kozue when she said she'd signed a secret contract forcing her to work part-time at the Teahouse, did you?
Paimon: Oh! Paimon just thought of another one. This one's quite good—
Paimon: "Just look at this visitor! Paimon, is it? Look at how cute and clever she is. Today, all her meals are on the house! *woof*"
{NICKNAME}: There's no way Taroumaru would say something like that.
Paimon: Hee-hee...
voices.title: About Taroumaru

voices.text:
Paimon: Hmm...
{NICKNAME}: What are you mulling over, Paimon?
Paimon: {NICKNAME}, do you remember Gorou's fluffy ears?
Paimon: Paimon really wants something like that... Or maybe horns similar to the ones Ganyu has. Ganyu's horns are pretty cute as well.
Paimon: {NICKNAME}, do you have any ideas?
{NICKNAME}: Let me see, hmm... Oh, I found something!
Paimon: Really? Aw, {NICKNAME}, Paimon always knew you were reliable!
{NICKNAME}: Ta-da! I present to you the Tusk of Monoceros Caeli!
Paimon: Paimon doesn't need that!
Paimon: *sigh* If Paimon can't have Gorou's fluffy ears, then maybe at least something like his fluffy tail...
{NICKNAME}: Bubadada! Here you go — Tail of Boreas!
Paimon: ...Not that! Also, combining those two is definitely not the look Paimon is going for!
voices.title: About Gorou

voices.text:
Paimon: It's amazing that Inazuma has places like the Yae Publishing House which specializes in publishing novels!
Paimon: They even host competitions! Wow!
{NICKNAME}: If that's the case, then perhaps you can submit a draft of the book you've been working on, "Paimon's Happiness."
Paimon: Well, about that... Paimon has misplaced the drafts on our way to Inazuma...
{NICKNAME}: ...Really?
Paimon: Fine! Paimon hasn't started writing it yet...
Paimon: It's not Paimon's fault! Paimon's been meaning to do it but three days ago, Paimon's pen broke. The day before yesterday, Paimon had hand cramps. Yesterday — a sprained foot. Today... Paimon... Hmmm... Paimon's hungry!
{NICKNAME}: Hehe, it sounds like you'll sooner write "A Thousand Excuses with Paimon" than "Paimon's Happiness."
voices.title: About Publishing Novels

voices.text:
Paimon: Kazuha is a free spirit, wouldn't you say?
{NICKNAME}: Yeah, he seems to be a bit of a loner too.
Paimon: Being able to explore the world at his leisure while savoring the beauty of everything around him. That doesn't sound too shabby...
Paimon: {NICKNAME}, you aren't thinking of sneaking off to go on a solo adventure, right?
{NICKNAME}: Aw, I would never leave you, Paimon.
Paimon: Paimon's really happy to hear that. Here... Hee—hee, have this...
{NICKNAME}: Monthly food expenses... 300,000 Mora!?
Paimon: Hey! Wait! {NICKNAME}, Where are you going?
{NICKNAME}: I suddenly feel like going solo. Maybe it's not a bad idea after all.
Paimon: Please don't go! Wait for Paimon!
voices.title: About Kaedehara Kazuha

voices.text:
Paimon: Hmmm...
{NICKNAME}: Paimon, you look so serious today.
Paimon: That's because Paimon's thinking about serious things.
Paimon: Paimon's jealous of people from wealthy and influential families. They have an endless supply of Mora and mountains of delicious food to eat...
{NICKNAME}: I can't disagree. Those are exactly the things you're fond of.
Paimon: But after getting to know Ayaka better, Paimon realized that a young lady from a noble family can also have her share of hardships.
Paimon: She needs to shoulder her clan's duties and responsibilities. She works so hard and has very little time for herself.
Paimon: Ayaka must be exhausted, she should try to relax a bit...
Paimon: Ah, that's right! Let's invite Ayaka to the next festival!
Paimon: If she got an invite from us, there's no way she'd refuse.
{NICKNAME}: Yeah, I'd like to go to another festival with her.
Paimon: Besides, if Ayaka's around, she can pick up the tab for us...
{NICKNAME}: ...I should've seen that coming...
voices.title: About Kamisato Ayaka

voices.text:
Paimon: Ayaka gives a sense of noble elegance with every gesture she makes.
{NICKNAME}: Can you do an Ayaka impression, Paimon?
Paimon: Let's give it a try.
Paimon: "Oh my, you've been picking mushrooms so earnestly just to make Chicken-Mushroom Skewers for me?"
Paimon: "How cute..."
{NICKNAME}: That was nothing like Ayaka. But...
{NICKNAME}: Even though you didn't sound like yourself, it didn't feel completely out of place for you either...
voices.title: About Imitating Ayaka

voices.text:
Paimon: It's a well-established tradition that during Inazuman celebrations everyone's wearing festive masks.
Paimon: Paimon tried to look around the stalls, but hasn't found any mask that fits...
{NICKNAME}: So you really want a mask of your own?
Paimon: Of course! Not wearing a mask during an Inazuman festival is the same as not receiving a bouquet at the Windblume Festival...
{NICKNAME}: Let me make one for you.
Paimon: Whoa! {NICKNAME}, you're the best!
{NICKNAME}: Hmmm, I wonder what kind of mask will fit you best? How about... a slime mask?
Paimon: Yay, Paimon Slime!
voices.title: About Festival Traditions

voices.text:
Paimon: Do you think Yoimiya's dad's poor hearing is related to fireworks?
Paimon: He's been making and testing fireworks for many years now, and being exposed to the sound of gunpowder explosions on a daily basis... Paimon can see how that might've worn down his ears...
Paimon: Yikes! Since Yoimiya is inheriting her family business, does that mean she'll have trouble hearing other people in the future, just like her dad?
Paimon: Paimon won't let that happen! Let's think of some way to help her!
{NICKNAME}: Do you have any suggestions, Paimon?
Paimon: Uh... Um...
Paimon: Paimon could follow Yoimiya around and cover her ears whenever needed...
{NICKNAME}: Then you'd need to leave me.
Paimon: ...Without Paimon, you'd lose your guide. Paimon wouldn't leave you like that!
Paimon: But... What should we do for Yoimiya...
{NICKNAME}: Actually, she can simply wear earplugs while working with fireworks.
Paimon: Oh yeah! Paimon didn't think of that solution! You're so smart!
{NICKNAME}: Heh... That was the first thing that came to my mind, but I wanted to give you an opportunity for a mental workout.
Paimon: Eh? So you knew this whole time, but didn't tell Paimon?
Paimon: How could you! You bully!
voices.title: About Yoimiya

voices.text:
Paimon: Sayu seems to have a lot on her mind.
Paimon: Paimon can't understand why she'd have so many worries.
{NICKNAME}: I guess this is what they call growing pains.
Paimon: Hmm, Paimon can't relate to that.
Paimon: After all, it's not Paimonly to worry too much.
{NICKNAME}: Hmmm...
{NICKNAME}: Bad news! We're almost out of Mora. I guess we'll have to tighten the purse strings for the next few days...
Paimon: Wh-What? Noooo!
{NICKNAME}: See, you're not as carefree as you thought.
Paimon: Ooh... How could you prank Paimon like that...
voices.title: About Sayu's Troubles

voices.text:
Paimon: Those Onikabuto bugs look so scary! The patterns on their backs are terrifying!
{NICKNAME}: Do you mean those demonic patterns? It's because they don't like to fight, so they purposely evolved their patterns in a way that scares their enemies away.
Paimon: That's really smart. We should try to learn a thing or two from them!
Paimon: We could borrow Xiao's mask. If a hilichurl saw you wearing it, do you think they'd run in fear?
{NICKNAME}: Uh... I don't think Xiao would agree to that...
Paimon: Yeah... Hmm, how about we ask Sayu to steal his mask for us?
Paimon: She knows ninjutsu that allows her to vanish into thin air. She can steal it for sure! Problem solved!
Paimon: Uh... If we are afraid of Xiao evening the score with us, how about we steal Childe's mask? We've kicked his butt many times before!
{NICKNAME}: I don't think stealing other people's belongings is a good idea. Also, what if Sayu doesn't agree to all of this?
Paimon: Th—Then let's... Let's visit Albedo first.
Paimon: If Albedo can develop a growth serum for Sayu, she'll help us for sure!
{NICKNAME}: Brilliant, now we just need you to come up with a way to make Albedo help us.
Paimon: Ugh! Paimon's head is going to explode. Let's stick to festival masks for now.
voices.title: About Onikabuto

voices.text:
Paimon: Even though Naku Weed has a flower-like structure, its "petals" are in fact leaves.
Paimon: Its actual bloom is rather fragile, so the surrounding leaves try their hardest to grow strong and protect it...
Paimon: Hee-hee, just like Paimon is protecting you right now.
{NICKNAME}: Just like you? Oh, is Naku Weed edible too?
Paimon: Yeah, that's right! ...Wait? What are you trying to say?
voices.title: About Naku Weed

voices.text:
Paimon: Did you know? The people in Inazuma use the vibrations of Naku Weed to forecast thunderstorms.
Paimon: Because Naku Weed grows in areas that are infused with Electro, it's naturally drawn to thunder and lightning.
{NICKNAME}: Does that mean Naku Weed is similar to you, Paimon?
Paimon: Eh? How so?
{NICKNAME}: You know, because you usually hang out in areas infused with gourmet food and are naturally drawn to tasty snacks!
Paimon: Hee-hee, that's true!
{NICKNAME}: Paimon radar activated...
Paimon: *beep* Delicacies, here we go!
voices.title: About Naku Weed and Storms

voices.text:
Paimon: The blossoms drifting down from the Sacred Sakura are so dazzling!
Paimon: Paimon heard that those flower petals can stay suspended in the air for so long because of being infused with Electro.
{NICKNAME}: Is it the same principle behind your levitation abilities?
Paimon: Uh... Ah... That's because...
{NICKNAME}: You do know what allows you to fly, don't you, Paimon?
Paimon: Paimon can fly because of... mysterious powers, obviously!
{NICKNAME}: Got it. Seems like you have no idea.
{NICKNAME}: How about we let Albedo do some research? He's good at cracking such mysteries...
Paimon: Please don't!
voices.title: About Sakura Blooms

voices.text:
Paimon: Lavender Melons sure are useful!
Paimon: Their flesh can be eaten, and their skin can be processed to make dyes.
{NICKNAME}: Paimon sure is useful!
{NICKNAME}: She can serve as my guide, and she can also give other people ugly nicknames, haha.
Paimon: Yep! Thank you for your validation!
Paimon: Wait a minute, is there more? Is Paimon about to get roasted?
Paimon: Paimon's gonna cover your mouth to stop you from talking!
voices.title: About Lavender Melons

voices.text:
Paimon: {NICKNAME}, have you noticed?
Paimon: In Inazuma, people who wear swords on their waists are a minority. Most soldiers use spears.
Paimon: Could it be that swords are a symbol of status... Should we wear them as well?
Paimon: But the swords here are all too big for Paimon... There's no other way, we'll have to find a famous swordsmith to make a custom one!
{NICKNAME}: A custom-made sword will cost a lot of Mora though.
Paimon: Are you saying that Mora is more important than the desires of your lovely companion?
{NICKNAME}: ...Actually, I've already prepared something for you, Paimon.
Paimon: Really? Really? Let's have a look!
Paimon: Hey! Isn't that the knife we use to cut fruit?
{NICKNAME}: Well, at least it's the right size for you...
{NICKNAME}: Ahem, "What matters isn't the value of the sword, it's the fighting spirit."
Paimon: Nice try, but Paimon won't fall for this, no matter how cool it sounds!
voices.title: About Swords

voices.text:
Paimon: Did you know there are hot springs in Inazuma?
{NICKNAME}: ...But there are no volcanoes.
Paimon: Umm, Paimon heard that the heat comes from a giant furnace!
Paimon: If we get the chance, Paimon also wants to check out a hot spring. Unfortunately, it seems like only the big shots are granted entry.
{NICKNAME}: Hmmm...
{NICKNAME}: Let's head back to the Dadaupa Gorge in Mondstadt!
Paimon: Eh? Why so sudden?
{NICKNAME}: Back in the Dadaupa Gorge, the hilichurls have a huge cauldron that's heated by Flaming Flowers. It should be similar to a hot spring, right? You can bathe in their... soup, I guess?
Paimon: ???
voices.title: About Hot Springs

voices.text:
Paimon: In Inazuma, it's customary for parents to choose a lucky name for their child.
{NICKNAME}: Those names symbolize everyone's expectations and wishes for the child, like prosperity, wealth, good health, and safety.
Paimon: Because of these expectations, parents often pick extra long names, and cram all sorts of blessings into them.
{NICKNAME}: So hypothetically, if one day a little girl fell into a lake on her way back home, then her friends might rush to her house to tell everyone, "Something bad happened!"
Paimon: "Oh, what happened?"
{NICKNAME}: Ozvaldo Hrafnavins, Prinzessin der Verurteilung Fischl von Luftschloss Narfidort, come quick! Centennial Genius Astrologist Mona Megistus has fallen into the water!
Paimon: ...Mona falling into the water doesn't sound like an emergency situation though.
{NICKNAME}: Precisely. The fast-swimming Mona would come back home around the same time her friends are done saying her name, haha.
voices.title: About Jugemu

voices.text:
Paimon: Inazuma's scenery is quite different than what we've seen so far.
{NICKNAME}: Yeah, Inazuma's an island nation.
Paimon: Before the invention of boats, how did the people living on different islands communicate with one another?
{NICKNAME}: According to Yoimiya's dad, they probably used smoke signals to transmit information.
{NICKNAME}: Or, they would...
Paimon: Yeah...?
{NICKNAME}: They would commission people who could freeze the water surface to travel between the islands and deliver messages.
Paimon: Whoa! If Kaeya had lived in Inazuma back then, he would've been even busier than Master Jean now!
voices.title: About Inazuma's Islands

voices.text:
Paimon: Tanuki are really mysterious creatures.
{NICKNAME}: I think they are really cute.
Paimon: Yeah, they're cute... until they start talking.
{NICKNAME}: Hmm, I wonder... If you couldn't talk, would you appear to be more mysterious and noble?
Paimon: Are you trying to mock me?
{NICKNAME}: *randomly humming innocently*
voices.title: About Tanuki

voices.text:
Paimon: Did anyone tell you that there are monsters called tanuki in Inazuma that can take on the form of any human they see?
{NICKNAME}: I heard such rumors before. They must know some mysterious transformation techniques.
Paimon: What if one day a tanuki tricked you by transforming into Paimon? Oh no... Paimon's worried now! 
{NICKNAME}: No worries, I'd surely be able to tell the difference— Wait! You're just concerned about my Mora, aren't you?
Paimon: Of course... Ah! ...No, no! Paimon's only concerned about your safety, {NICKNAME}!
Paimon: Hmph, stop looking at Paimon like that. *pouting* Look, just think about it! If there were two Paimons, how would you find out which one is the real one?
{NICKNAME}: ...Eh-he.
Paimon: What do you mean "eh-he"!?
{NICKNAME}: See, only the real Paimon would respond like that.
Paimon: Ah! Paimon got tricked again...
voices.title: About Tanuki and Their Illusions

voices.text:
Paimon: We've been passing by a lot of small shrines lately, but none of them seem to be dedicated to the Electro Archon.
{NICKNAME}: They were probably built for lesser deities. The people of Inazuma believe that everything around them has a spirit, and those spirits will help them in their time of need.
Paimon: Oh, so the people make shrines for them, and give them offerings.
{NICKNAME}: Yeah. In a way, it's a form of prayer and a token of appreciation.
Paimon: Paimon gets it now! Let's find Ayaka, and have her put up a shrine for us!
Paimon: If we do that, we'll be able to get lots of offerings as well!
Paimon: Paimon's so happy!
{NICKNAME}: Uh... I—Is that an acceptable thing to do?
Paimon: What's wrong? Haven't we been helping out everyone this whole time? We may be doing an even better job than those deities!
{NICKNAME}: You do have a point...
{NICKNAME}: But when I picture people placing flowers or fruits in front of a shrine for me... it doesn't feel right.
voices.title: About Other Shrines

voices.text:
{NICKNAME}: It never stops raining on Yashiori Island. I heard it's because of the lingering evil energy.
Paimon: "Evil energy"? What's that? Sounds terrifying.
{NICKNAME}: It's caused by the remains of an evil god somewhere on the island. Because its power hasn't fully dispersed, the remaining energy causes all sorts of misfortunes. That's what I meant when I said "evil energy."
Paimon: Oh, that makes sense. But Paimon doesn't think rain is a bad thing.
Paimon: Maybe that god has been crying all this time because they were bullied.
{NICKNAME}: Crying? I don't think gods can cry. I mean, I've never seen Venti or Zhongli cry before.
Paimon: There are exceptions! If you pinch Paimon, you'll be able to see a crying god.
{NICKNAME}: Hmm? Are you a god?
Paimon: Paimon sure is!
{NICKNAME}: Okay, let me guess... The flying god of silly questions? The god of slimes? Or the god of being fished out from the water?
Paimon: Paimon's none of those! Hmph!
Paimon: As your bodyguard, {NICKNAME}, Paimon is the god of protection! Hehe.
voices.title: About the Rain on Yashiori Island

voices.text:
{NICKNAME}: In Hanamizaka, there's a place called the Bantan Sango Detective Agency.
Paimon: Paimon remembers. It's the one run by Sango and Ryuuji, right? Everyone speaks highly of them.
{NICKNAME}: Uh, I heard that they frequently get caught up in strange incidents, and some places have banned them from entering their premises...
Paimon: Paimon thinks that's undeserved. After all, Sango and Ryuuji have helped a lot of people...
{NICKNAME}: Would you invite them if you were organizing a dinner party?
{NICKNAME}: What if halfway through the meal, one of the guests suddenly shrieked and collapsed onto the ground...
Paimon: I—If that's the case, then Paimon thinks it's a bad idea. Paimon suddenly feels that hanging out with them could be dangerous...
{NICKNAME}: Well, that's the price you pay for being a famous detective.
voices.title: About Bantan Sango Detective Agency

voices.text:
Paimon: Oh yeah, have you drawn fortune slips at the shrine before, {NICKNAME}?
Paimon: If we draw them before our next adventure, they may provide us with some guidance.
{NICKNAME}: Hmm, but what if our draws are inauspicious or turn out to be a bad omen? If that happened, we'd probably end up in a bad mood...
Paimon: Oh, that's fine. According to the shrine maidens, if someone draws a bad omen, they just need to hang it on a tree in the shrine...
Paimon: So, we should keep on drawing and drawing, until we get a super lucky draw! Then, we'll hang all the bad ones on the tree!
{NICKNAME}: If everyone did that, there'd be no more space left to hang the slips...
voices.title: About Drawing Fortune Slips

voices.text:
Paimon: Musou no Hitotachi is amazing!
Paimon: It can beat any enemy with a single slash!
{NICKNAME}: Uh, but for Childe, it might need three slashes...
Paimon: Y—Yeah!
Paimon: Anyway, if you mastered that technique, Paimon wouldn't have to worry about you for the rest of our journey!
{NICKNAME}: So, where can one learn that technique?
Paimon: Yeah, where can one learn that technique?
{NICKNAME}: Hm?
Paimon: Quit looking at Paimon like that! O—Okay, Paimon will keep an eye on you during our adventures...
voices.title: About Musou no Hitotachi

voices.text:
Paimon: Did you know, {NICKNAME}? That Sangonomiya Kokomi, she's Watatsumi Island's Divine Priestess.
Paimon: In other words, she's the ruler of Watatsumi Island! The whole of Watatsumi Island is controlled by her.
Paimon: Paimon also wants to become a big shot like her...
{NICKNAME}: What will you do after you become a big shot?
Paimon: Then, Paimon will deliver justice. For example... Ahem.
Paimon: The suspect in question, known as the Traveler, ate two Dango for lunch and only gave one to the victim, Paimon. This is a serious violation of article thirty seven, "Fairness and Justice," of the "Paimon Decree."
{NICKNAME}: Oh... may I ask how Your Excellency Paimon plans to resolve this issue?
Paimon: Of course. As compensation for your wrongdoings, you will have to make even more Dango for Paimon, hee-hee!
voices.title: About Sangonomiya Kokomi

voices.text:
Paimon: Paimon wonders what the previous Shogun was like.
{NICKNAME}: It appears that she was a person who understood the fleeting nature of things, and accepted the inevitable fate of departing this world one day.
Paimon: After all, realizing the fragility of things in front of you makes you treasure them even more.
{NICKNAME}: This way of thinking must've influenced Inazuma's aesthetics. This world is transient, people come and go. The fun times we shared, our companionship, and the delicious foods we got to savor — those emotions and experiences are real things that existed at some point in time, not just empty concepts.
Paimon: Even though... Even though every banquet must eventually come to an end, it'd be nice to enjoy those happy moments for a little longer.
{NICKNAME}: "Shifting seasons and elusive dreams, the ephemeral and fleeting, with thine companionship, all are eternal."
Paimon: Paimon doesn't get it!
{NICKNAME}: I'm saying that I'm having a lot of fun traveling with you, Paimon. It'd be nice if we could just go on like this forever.
Paimon: Paimon'll take your word for it then.
voices.title: About Transience

voices.text:
Paimon: The clothes that shrine maidens wear are quite unique.
{NICKNAME}: I heard that after the Sakoku Decree is lifted, Yae Miko plans to run a rental service where people can try on shrine maiden outfits as a tourist attraction in various places. Combined with the latest Kamera technology from Fontaine, it seems like a real Mora maker.
Paimon: Oh!
{NICKNAME}: {M#The shrine maidens in the Grand Shrine even asked me if I knew any pretty girls who are willing to become models. All they need to do is to dress up in a shrine maiden outfit and smile to the Kamera. They even asked me to be a model and said all I needed was some makeup.}{F#The shrine maidens in the Grand Shrine even asked me if I was interested in becoming a model! All I need to do is wear a shrine maiden outfit and smile to the Kamera. They also asked me if I knew any other cute girls.}
Paimon: What!?
{NICKNAME}: I immediately shared this idea with Rosaria. I feel like they can do something similar at the Church of Favonius with the garments they wear.
Paimon: Wait, Paimon doesn't think that a...
{NICKNAME}: Sadly, Rosaria found the idea of it too troublesome.
Paimon: Maybe it's for the better...
voices.title: About Shrine Maidens

voices.text:
Paimon: Aoi gave Paimon a painting. Turns out it's not edible, but Paimon is still very happy with that gift!
{NICKNAME}: Aoi? The general goods shop owner? Let me see.
Paimon: Here, but be careful. It was painted by a famous artist, Utamarou. It's quite valuable!
{NICKNAME}: Utamarou? Hmm... I think I've heard that name before...
Paimon: Of course, master Utamarou's works can be found all around Inazuma after all!
Paimon: Did you see one of them in Ayaka's residence? The one that Paimon has right now isn't too shabby either.
{NICKNAME}: Oh, I remember now! One of those paintings was used by Yoimiya as kindling, right?
Paimon: Eh? Kindling?
{NICKNAME}: Uh, yeah! I think Thoma used it as padding for table legs as well.
Paimon: What? Padding?
{NICKNAME}: And, if I remember correctly, I also saw Sayu use a stack of those paintings as a cushion for her nap.
Paimon: Sayu has several of those works? That can't be right...
{NICKNAME}: Real masterpieces aren't mass-produced. If you ask me, that Utamarou isn't a real master at all.
Paimon: Hey—
voices.title: About the Artist Utamarou

voices.text:
Paimon: The Komore Teahouse is doing surprisingly well. They have a great number of visitors every day.
Paimon: We should also open a teahouse. Paimon feels that it'd be really profitable!
{NICKNAME}: Hmm... Well, if we do end up opening a teahouse, then you're gonna be the boss, for sure.
Paimon: Eh? Deal!
Paimon: Paimon didn't think that you'd have so much faith in Paimon's abilities... Paimon will make sure to be a responsible manager, and make our shop the best teahouse in Teyvat!
{NICKNAME}: Uhh, I don't think it'd need to be managed... Do you remember Taroumaru?
Paimon: Yup, he's the owner of the Komore Teahouse, right? A lot of the clients go to the Teahouse to play with him rather than drink tea.
{NICKNAME}: So I was thinking, if you were running the shop, you'd definitely be more popular than Taroumaru.
Paimon: Hee-hee, of course... Hey! So you don't really trust Paimon's management skills, you just want a mascot!?
voices.title: About the Teahouse and Its Owner

voices.text:
{NICKNAME}: With the abolishment of the Vision Hunt Decree, I guess the Sakoku Decree will be the next one to go.
Paimon: Here's hoping that everything goes well.
{NICKNAME}: Let's encourage everyone to hold on for just a bit longer.
Paimon: Yeah!
{NICKNAME}: If we get the chance, let's find Atsuko and tell her that the sakura trees in her homeland are blooming.
Paimon: How is that supposed to comfort her!?
voices.title: About the Sakoku Decree

voices.text:
Paimon: *sigh* Ogura Mio says that she hardly has any fancy kimonos in stock these days. So, chances are that you won't be able to buy one, even if you can afford it.
Paimon: It's a real tragedy... Paimon wants to look glamorous, too.
{NICKNAME}: But the Sakoku Decree's been abolished... She should be able to import silk from Liyue now.
Paimon: *gasp* You're right! Great, so there's hope for Paimon's kimono-dream after all!
Paimon: Just imagine it... Paimon emerges from Ogura's shop wearing a custom-made pure-silk one-of-a-kind kimono. Total transformation! This Paimon's going places!
Paimon: No longer just a sidekick in the legendary Traveler's adventure story... Oh no, say hello to Paimon the Elegant, wearer of fine silks and fated friend of heroes!
Paimon: Ahhh... Wouldn't that be amazing?
Paimon: ...It would, wouldn't it, {NICKNAME}? Um, so—
{NICKNAME}: What I'm hearing is... you want me to pay for your new wardrobe.
Paimon: Exactly, you read Paimon's mind! See, that's what being "fated friends" is all about!
Paimon: Um, so Paimon was thinking seven different styles, one for each day of the week. Still not sure on the specific designs though, let Paimon think...
{NICKNAME}: ...Uh, suddenly, I'm not so interested in buying.
voices.title: About Kimonos

voices.text: Hyah!
voices.title: Elemental Skill: X

voices.text: Scatter!
voices.title: Elemental Skill: XI

voices.text: Propagate!
voices.title: Elemental Skill: XII

voices.text: Hyah!
voices.title: Elemental Burst: X

voices.text: Germinate!
voices.title: Elemental Burst: XI

voices.text: Spring forth!
voices.title: Elemental Burst: XII

voices.text:
Paimon: Free knowledge without having to study at all? Canned Knowledge is amazing!
Paimon: Could Sumeru have Canned Knowledge about the different customs of the seven nations, too?
Paimon: If so, Paimon could just open a can every time we get to a new place. Paimon wouldn't have to explain things ever again!
{NICKNAME}: Or we could just open them all here in Sumeru.
Paimon: But... but traveling wouldn't be any fun without surprises to look forward to!
{NICKNAME}: Plus, if we opened them all here, I wouldn't even need Paimon as a guide anymore.
Paimon: Okay scrap that idea! No more Canned Knowledge. Let's save our Mora for something else!
Paimon: Something like... Oh! Tipping Paimon for guide services! Heehee, seems fair, right?
voices.title: About Canned Knowledge

voices.text:
Paimon: The Eremites are a real motley crew...
{NICKNAME}: There's certainly a diverse range of characters.
Paimon: Hmmm... yeah, that could explain it! Paimon can play lots of different characters too.
Paimon: Judgy Paimon, knowledgeable Paimon, helpful Paimon...
{NICKNAME}: ...And of course the classic, completely-misses-the-point Paimon.
voices.title: About The Eremites

voices.text:
Paimon: Have you noticed something? People in Sumeru don't seem to have a lot of faith in Lesser Lord Kusanali.
Paimon: Back in Liyue and Inazuma, people were pretty enthusiastic about Rex Lapis and the Almighty Shogun.
Paimon: Those strange scholars are one thing, but even everyone living downtown only ever seems to talk about Greater Lord Rukkhadevata.
{NICKNAME}: Yeah, that's true... Even the most delicious mushrooms are said to be Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's blessing.
Paimon: Speaking of which, lots of the dishes in Liyue are said to have been taught and approved by Rex Lapis himself...
Paimon: Aha! So as long as a god blesses their people with delicious food, people will worship them!
{NICKNAME}: If their name is Paimon, sure.
Paimon: Huh? Wait, so... {NICKNAME}, what do you believe in, then?
{NICKNAME}: Me? Hehe... Paimon, of course.
Paimon: Heehee, that's right!
voices.title: About Beliefs

voices.text:
Paimon: The first time we saw the Wall of Samiel, Paimon was stunned... It seems to go on forever.
{NICKNAME}: Well, it was built to protect the entire rainforest, after all.
Paimon: And, it's so, so tall...
Paimon: Who knows if {NICKNAME}'ll be able to climb all the way to the top.
{NICKNAME}: I doubt it...? Also, why do I have to climb it, exactly?
Paimon: Uh... because it's right there?
{NICKNAME}: Hmm, even so... No.
Paimon: The Wall of Samiel is right there in front of us!
{NICKNAME}: I know, I know, but it's way too—
Paimon: But it's the Wall of Samiel...
{NICKNAME}: Fine! I'll go, okay?
voices.title: About the Wall of Samiel

voices.text:
Paimon: All these Sumeru scholars seem to wear Akasha Terminals so they can get information from the Akasha system.
Paimon: It's like they're carrying an interactive encyclopedia with them wherever they go. Paimon's kinda jealous.
{NICKNAME}: Well, I'm not jealous. I have an even better encyclopedia that automatically follows me around, gives me the A-to-Z on everything in Teyvat, and the best part is, it can even talk!
Paimon: Huh? Was that a compliment? Aw, you're making Paimon blush... Paimon definitely doesn't know as much as an encyclopedia! A-to-Y at most.
{NICKNAME}: Well, you know... maybe if you ate a little less, you'd have room for Z, too.
Paimon: Hey!!!
voices.title: About Akasha Terminals

voices.text:
Paimon: Arama, Arana, Araja, Arakavi... Whew, Aranara names are so hard to remember...
Paimon: The only bit Paimon's sure of is that they all start with "Ara"!
{NICKNAME}: Right, so if you were an Aranara, your name would be "Arapaimon."
Paimon: Yup, and as for {NICKNAME}...
Paimon: Hmm, actually, they'd probably call you Nara {NICKNAME}...
{NICKNAME}: Yeah, we're all Nara to them...
Paimon: So if there was someone whose actual name was "Nara," what would the Aranara call them?
{NICKNAME}: "Nara Nara"... I guess. Sounds kinda cute.
Paimon: Hehe, yeah.
voices.title: About Aranara Names

voices.text:
Paimon: For some reason, the Aranara's food all tasted a little too... um, how to put this... a little too "fresh."
Paimon: It's totally different from what we usually eat.
{NICKNAME}: Yeah, but their ingredients are top-quality.
Paimon: Yeah, that's true. Still, those mushrooms and fruits were so raw, it felt like they were gonna keep growing in Paimon's stomach!
{NICKNAME}: Heh, you're exaggerating, right? You do have a point, though — maybe the best ingredients don't need a lot of fancy cooking.
Paimon: You're right. If the ingredients are good enough, they'll taste great even when cooked with the simplest methods.
{NICKNAME}: Just like Paimon. Just a little salt and pepper, and—
Paimon: Hey! For crying out loud, we're in Sumeru now! Don't you think that joke's getting a little old?
voices.title: About Aranara Cuisine

voices.text:
Paimon: How did a genie that big get into Dori's lamp?
{NICKNAME}: There's only one way to find out: In you go, Paimon.
Paimon: Not a chance! There's no way Paimon would fit in there!
{NICKNAME}: Okay, well... if you want, you can be the genie of the Serenitea Pot instead?
Paimon: Oooh, great idea! Paimon's down!
{NICKNAME}: You seem pretty excited about this...
Paimon: Uh, yeah! Paimon's been wanting to try this for ages! ...Poof! Didst thou summon me, O Traveler from a distant land?
Paimon: Come on, come on, now you have to grant Paimon three wishes! Paimon's first wish is... bring Paimon lots of delicious food!
{NICKNAME}: Paimon, you're not supposed to be the one making wishes!
voices.title: About Dori's Genie

voices.text:
Paimon: Whoa, healthcare is FREE in Sumeru?
{NICKNAME}: Are you feeling unwell, Paimon?
Paimon: No, not right now. Thanks for asking, though.
Paimon: Hehe... Eating the street food on every corner has never sounded so tempting!
{NICKNAME}: Your stomach is gonna punish you for that!
Paimon: If so, Paimon'll go see a doctor and get treated — it's all for free! It'd be a waste not to take advantage of this, don't you think?
{NICKNAME}: Maybe... But then again, the treatment would likely include a restricted diet.
Paimon: *gasp* Oh no! So no more delicious food, then?
{NICKNAME}: That, plus the doctor would make you take the most bitter-tasting medicine ever.
Paimon: O—Okay... Maybe Paimon needs to reconsider this idea...
voices.title: About Bimarstan

voices.text:
Paimon: So many people in Sumeru want to become scholars.
Paimon: Motivated by this ambition, they all study really hard to try and achieve it...
Paimon: But Paimon bets that the first ever scholar didn't set out to become a scholar...
Paimon: Hmm... so what do you think the first ever scholar's ambition was?
{NICKNAME}: Probably... to get their research paper written as quickly as possible.
Paimon: Huh? But isn't a scholar's ultimate goal supposed to be "pursuing the highest and greatest knowledge" or something?
Paimon: Paimon's sure that it must have been because of a fervent desire for knowledge that they became Sumeru's first true scholar.
{NICKNAME}: Writing papers is how you pursue knowledge.
Paimon: But what about when it's the highest and greatest knowledge of all...
{NICKNAME}: Even then, if you wanted to prove it, you'd need a research paper.
{NICKNAME}: And after that, you'd need to start working on another paper to validate your original thesis...
Paimon: O—Okay, Paimon's got it! Come on, don't look so sad! It's not like you have to worry about writing papers yourself!
Paimon: ...Y—You've never had to write a paper before, right...?
voices.title: About the Scholars

voices.text:
Paimon: Paimon wants to go visit the Amurta scholars!
{NICKNAME}: When did you become such an avid student, Paimon?
Paimon: Well, Paimon heard that the Amurta scholars' research is all about nature.
Paimon: Which means... they must have to research which animals are edible, and which ones taste the best, and... y'know that kind of thing!
Paimon: Paimon thinks it'd be really fun to help them out with their research.
{NICKNAME}: In other words, you've got a craving for some tasty, organic dishes.
Paimon: No! Paimon genuinely thinks that it's a really meaningful research topic and wants to help out!
{NICKNAME}: Hmm, well in that case... I think the Amurta scholars might be more interested to find out about Paimon's species and behavioral patterns.
Paimon: Uh... Gee is that the time? Paimon just remembered we have something else more important to do!
voices.title: About Amurta

voices.text:
Paimon: Sumpter Beasts are adorable! Paimon likes how the people who keep them give them each a special name based on their most distinctive traits!
{NICKNAME}: For all we know, the Sumpter Beasts might be giving each of us a name in return. Maybe that's how they respond when we call their name.
Paimon: Really? So what kind of name do think they'd give us?
{NICKNAME}: (Sumpter Beast noises)
Paimon: How is anyone supposed to understand that!
{NICKNAME}: A rough translation would be...
{NICKNAME}: "Vociferous Pestiferous Melliculus Niveous Micro-Bipedal."
